dictation.activationPhraseHint: When set, only speech that opens with this phrase is sent, and the phrase itself is removed first. The match runs on this machine, so unrelated speech never leaves it. Try “computer”. Leave empty to send every utterance.
dictation.activationPhraseSuggestion: Try “computer”: it is distinctive, Whisper transcribes it reliably, and ordinary speech rarely contains it. Leave the field empty to send every utterance.
dictation.autoSendHint: Automatically press Enter after inserting transcribed text
dictation.correctionsHint: Automatically replace dictation output. Useful for technical terms.
dictation.earconsHint: Play a short sound when a turn is sent to the agent, and a lower one when a turn without the activation phrase is dropped. Only the device you talk into plays them.
dictation.handsFreeListeningHint: Keep the microphone open and send each utterance by itself. Turn off to dictate with push-to-talk only; with spoken replies on, the agent still answers out loud. Applies to the next conversation.
dictation.spokenRepliesOnTitle: Spoken replies on: click to turn off
dictation.spokenRepliesOffTitle: Spoken replies off: click to turn on
dictation.spokenRepliesHint: Let the agent answer out loud. Turn off to keep dictation and receive text replies.
dictation.handsFreeHint: Push-to-talk is the hotkey above: hold it, speak, release. Hands-free binds one terminal, keeps the microphone open and sends each utterance by itself. Use {hotkey} to start or stop hands-free on the active terminal.
dictation.holdBackHint: How long a finished utterance is shown before it is sent, so you can stop one you did not mean. Applies to the next conversation, not the one already running.
dictation.hotkeyHint: Hold the hotkey to start recording, release to stop. Short presses pass through as normal input.
dictation.languageHint: Auto-detect works well for most languages.
dictation.languageNoVoiceHint: Replies in this language will not be spoken. Whisper also expects you to speak it — if you talk in another language, choose it or Auto-detect.
dictation.levellingHint: Evens out quiet and loud words within a reply. Off keeps the voice as recorded.
dictation.longPressHint: How long to hold the key before dictation starts. 0 = instant (no short-press pass-through), higher = fewer accidental triggers.
dictation.microphoneHint: Select the input device to use for dictation.
dictation.modelHint: Choose a model. Larger models are more accurate but slower.
dictation.noSpeechHint: Discards a transcript when Whisper itself reports it probably heard no speech. Lower is stricter; 100% turns the gate off.
dictation.notifyModelHint: Tell the agent when a hands-free conversation starts, so it answers out loud, and when it ends, so it goes back to text. Turning this off never leaves speech running: disarming always stops it.
dictation.ownedElsewhere: Dictation is owned by another TUICommander instance on this configuration. Use it there; this instance does not register the global hotkey, watch the Fn key or open the microphone. Restart this instance after the other one quits to take dictation over.
dictation.rmsHint: Audio below this level is ignored.
dictation.speechCommandHint: One argument per line, no shell. {out} is the WAV file the command must write; {text} and {voice} are optional (without {text}, the text arrives on stdin).
dictation.speechEngineHint: Edge is the default. Pocket TTS runs entirely on this machine after a download. An external command is your own engine.
dictation.speechHint: Downloads needed to let an agent answer out loud. The runtime library is shared; each language is a separate bundle and brings its own voices.
dictation.speechHintEdge: Replies are spoken with Microsoft Edge neural voices: nothing to download, but each reply's text is sent to Microsoft's online speech service, so it needs an internet connection.
dictation.speechHintExternal: Replies are spoken by the command below, which runs on this machine as you.
dictation.speechLanguageAuto: Whatever Whisper hears — nothing is spoken until somebody speaks
dictation.speechLanguageMissing: {lang} — no speech bundle ships for it
dictation.startNoticeHint: What the agent reads when a conversation starts. Leave it empty to send the built-in text shown in grey.
dictation.tuningHint: Record a test phrase and watch where your voice sits against the gates. Text stays in this panel — nothing is sent to a terminal.
dictation.voiceHint: Changing the voice stops any reply already being spoken — a sentence half said in one voice does not finish in another.
dictation.voiceVolumeHint: How loud every reply is spoken. Peaks are limited, so a high level never clips. Applies to the next reply.
dictation.voicesHint: Each voice is a separate download. A voice file you add must be made for this language's model (.safetensors); TUICommander does not create voices.

settings.catalogue.agents.hibernate_idle: Minutes of awake idle time; zero disables automatic hibernation.
settings.catalogue.agents.hibernate_scop: Only in background or always; watched and working agents remain live.
settings.agents.abandonedHint: Zero disables automatic closure. Plain shells are marked abandoned after one idle hour. Running processes, managed sessions and uncertain process observations are never closed.

mcpAudit.title: Call audit
mcpAudit.toggleHint: Keeps a body-free log of recent agent tool calls (operation, outcome, size, effect) in memory. Off by default in release builds.
mcpAudit.effect.completedHint: The handler returned successfully. Queued work may still run; client delivery is not confirmed.
mcpAudit.effect.readOnlyHint: The read-only handler returned successfully without a mutating operation.
mcpAudit.effect.failedHint: The handler returned an application error. This does not prove rollback of partial changes.
mcpAudit.effect.notStartedHint: The request was refused before the operation started.
mcpAudit.effect.unknownHint: Completion is uncertain: the call was cancelled, the handler was interrupted, or an upstream reply was lost. Partial effects may still have occurred.
mcpAudit.failed: Could not load the call audit.
